attr.title: Fear & Hunger
attr.desc: Descend into the dungeons of Fear & Hunger, a brutal survival horror RPG where limbs come off, the dark is real and saving costs you something. RPG Maker MV on an NW.js runtime. Needs firmware with DRM/KMS graphics: ROCKNIX, not KNULLI.
attr.inst: Requires firmware with DRM/KMS graphics - ROCKNIX works, KNULLI on the same hardware cannot draw at all. Copy the www/ folder from your own Steam installation into the fearandhunger/ folder, alongside the engine. Then run fearandhunger/tools/optimize_audio.py over www/audio on a PC: without it the game needs more memory than a 1 GB device has. See README.md for the frame rate settings.
